title: Luke
author: Luke the physician and companion of Paul.
historicalSetting: Luke presents an orderly account of Jesus' life, compassion, salvation, and the work of the Spirit.
keyVerse: Luke 19:10 — "For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost."
christFocus: Luke centers on Christ as the Savior who seeks the lost, welcomes sinners, fulfills God's promise, and sends His people in the Spirit's power.
